title: Z Group — Bilingual Real Estate Corporate Website & CMS
summary: A bilingual (EN/AR) corporate website and admin content management system that lets a real estate development company autonomously manage projects, marketing pages, and leads.
description: Z Group is a full digital ecosystem for a premier real estate developer, combining a public marketing site with a private admin console. Visitors can browse active, upcoming, and previous projects with galleries, floor plans, amenities, location maps, and construction timelines; submit project inquiries, register interest on landing pages, and apply for careers. The authenticated admin dashboard gives the marketing team complete control over project listings, a modular drag-and-drop landing page builder, every site section and SEO setting, and all form submissions — removing the need for developer intervention for every content change.
highlights: Engineered a modular, typed section-based landing page builder (hero, stats, content, features, gallery, CTA) with reorder/enable/disable controls persisted as a typed union of MongoDB models.

Built a custom weighted SEO scoring engine (SeoAnalyzer) with 8 rule checkers (title, description, headings, keyword density, images, URL, content structure, readability) that scores and recommends fixes for both English and Arabic content.

Designed a bilingual-first data model with localized {en, ar} strings throughout, an RTL-aware frontend, and an aggregated analytics dashboard powered by MongoDB aggregation pipelines across 11 collections.
features: Bilingual public site (English/Arabic) with next-intl i18n, locale routing, and RTL support
Project portfolio with gallery images/videos, floor plans, amenities, nearby places, partner logos, and location maps
Under-construction project pages with construction progress timelines and image sets
Previous projects showcase with reorderable item management
Admin dashboard with portfolio stats, donut/bar charts, recent activity, and quick actions
Drag-and-drop landing page builder with modular content sections and draft/publish workflow
Site settings manager for home, about, milestones, achievement video, footer, and page SEO
Integrated real-time SEO analyzer with weighted scores and actionable recommendations
Form submission management for project inquiries, landing page interest, careers (CV upload), and about-us contacts
JWT-based admin authentication with bcrypt password hashing and admin-only RBAC middleware
challenges: Modeling a flexible yet type-safe section-based page system: a discriminated union of section models (Hero, Stats, Content, Features, Gallery, CTA) with per-section props, ordering, and enabled flags on both the API and the client renderer.

Implementing a locale-aware weighted SEO analysis engine that evaluates content quality independently for English and Arabic, computing a live score from passed/total rule weights and surfacing severity-ranked issues in the editor.

Orchestrating a single aggregated dashboard endpoint that concurrently counts, trends, and snapshots data across 11 MongoDB collections using Promise.all and aggregation pipelines while keeping consistent response shapes for the charting UI.
architecture: Next.js 16 App Router frontend with next-intl locale routing (en/ar) and RTL support, consuming an Express 5 REST API backed by MongoDB (native driver) for content with PostgreSQL via pg for relational data. JWT access tokens in httpOnly cookies with bcrypt hashing protect admin routes, Multer handles media/CV uploads served as static files, and Zod validates all payloads.

title: Pulse Dashboard
summary: A performance analytics dashboard for marketing teams tracking campaign performance in real time.
description: Pulse Dashboard centralizes performance data for product, sales, and marketing teams. It offers live KPI monitoring, trend analysis, and exportable reports so teams can act quickly on shifts across channels and conversion funnels.
highlights: Implemented live KPI widgets with fast refresh and trend comparisons.
Built event-based filters to let teams isolate campaign performance by source and segment.
Created exportable reports that updated the business review workflow.
features: Live dashboard widgets with real-time data refresh
Campaign breakdowns by traffic source and conversion rate
Custom time-range filters and exportable reports
Shared team views with role-based permissions
challenges: Handling large analytics datasets without sacrificing responsiveness.
Designing a consistent dashboard language across multiple business teams.
Reducing noise in campaign data while preserving the ability to drill down.
architecture: React dashboard frontend, Node.js ingestion service, PostgreSQL data layer, and charting utilities for live reporting.
role: Full-stack engineer focused on product analytics and dashboard UX.

title: Orbit TaskFlow
summary: A collaborative task and workflow management app for growing product teams.
description: Orbit TaskFlow helps distributed teams plan work, keep priorities aligned, and move projects from kickoff to delivery. With task boards, sprint tracking, and real-time updates, it gives teams clarity without adding operational friction.
highlights: Designed an interactive team workflow that encouraged momentum across multiple projects.
Enabled live updates for comments, status changes, and assignee actions.
Built sprint planning views that keep execution and reporting aligned.
features: Kanban board with drag-and-drop task updates
Sprint planning with due date tracking and visibility
Real-time sync across team members and comments
Automated reminders and activity feed
challenges: Balancing a light interface with rich workflow detail.
Supporting team collaboration without creating noisy activity streams.
Preserving fast UX when project data changed frequently.
architecture: React front end with Firebase real-time syncing, TypeScript models, and modular board state management.

title: Harbor Logistics
summary: A logistics management system for tracking shipments, inventory, and fulfillment performance.
description: Harbor Logistics provides a complete operational view for shipping teams managing warehouse movement and delivery schedules. It simplifies routing, order handoff, and shipment visibility while delivering clean reporting to support business decisions.
highlights: Added live shipment milestones and status tracking for faster operational updates.
Designed a warehouse dashboard to visualize fulfillment flow and bottlenecks.
Connected orders and inventory data to support stronger delivery planning.
features: Shipment tracking and milestone event logging
Warehouse inventory sync across multiple locations
Driver assignment and delivery route insights
Operational dashboards for SLA and fulfillment health
challenges: Reducing signal noise across many moving shipment events.
Connecting fulfillment data across disconnected operational tools.
Providing actionable insights without overwhelming operational teams.
architecture: Next.js app shell, Node.js API services, MongoDB operational datasets, and dashboard views for live supply chain monitoring.
role: Full-stack engineer leading operational tooling and UI design.
